prompt:

Header text verbatim: "nittio". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "ninety".
Scene: A clean educational abacus-style display of exactly nine full rows of ten blue beads, ninety beads in all, with a large separate numeral "90" centered above; no tenth row or scattered beads.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "nittio = ninety; do not confuse it with nitton, nineteen.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Tio mindre än hundra är nittio.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
